The gauge used to monitor the oven temperature will be recalibrated to ensure accuracy and precision. Additionally, a Measurement System Analysis (MSA) study will be conducted before the next production run to validate the measurement process and ensure that it is functioning within specified limits. These actions will help to mitigate the risk of process parameter drift and minimize the potential for FOD events in the machine shop.

The investigation revealed that the gauge had not been recalibrated as required, and a Measurement System Analysis (MSA) study had not been conducted to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the measurement system. As a result, the measurement system was not capable of producing accurate measurements, leading to the FOD event. To prevent similar incidents from occurring in the future, it has been determined that gauge recalibration and an MSA study are required before the next production run. These corrective actions will ensure that the measurement system is accurate and reliable, minimizing the risk of FOD events. The implementation of these actions will be monitored to ensure that the root cause of the incident has been adequately addressed.
